gaps.sentence: The matter ___ at this very moment, so no comment yet.
gaps.explanation: Look into (investigate) passivises with the particle kept: is being looked into.

gaps.sentence: The house looked deserted; it ___ (empty) years earlier.
gaps.hint: past event before another past point
gaps.explanation: 'Years earlier' is before the past reference point, so past perfect passive: had been + emptied.

gaps.sentence: I couldn't use the meeting room because it ___ (clean) all morning.
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive: was being + cleaned over a period in the past.

gaps.sentence: The finalists ___ (interview) live on air as we speak.
gaps.explanation: 'As we speak' demands the present continuous passive: are being + interviewed.

gaps.sentence: The new bridge ___ (open) by the mayor next month.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + opened, with the agent in a by-phrase.

gaps.sentence: The bridge ___ (CLOSE) to traffic since the landslide.
gaps.hint: state continuing since a past point
gaps.explanation: 'Since' with a continuing state takes the present perfect passive: has been closed.

gaps.sentence: The tickets ___ at the door from seven o'clock.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: can be + collected. The tickets are collected by the buyers.

gaps.sentence: The fault ___ by the time the auditor arrived.
gaps.explanation: The fixing preceded the arrival: past perfect passive had been + fixed.
